notes.title: Endless & Achievements update | 1.1
notes.content:
Quick update on the endless mode and achievements.
Custom songs now support the Dashlab OST (which means that night themed songs also work in endless mode), and the game now has achievements that you can unlock on Steam.


[b]Changelogs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Steam achievements
[*] Custom songs now feature the Dashlab OST
[*] Improved custom songs support
[*] Added 5 new room in Endless mode
[*] Fixed overflow zone
[*] Various fixes
[/list]
